sentence: In buildDomainOverview and buildDomainDetail the parameter graph is typed KnowledgeGraph whose edges property is GraphEdge[], and edges from graph.edges (and stepEdges filtered from it) are read for source, target and weight.
filteredGraph is typed KnowledgeGraph | null and each node in filteredGraph.nodes.map is a GraphNode whose summary, complexity and tags are read into the node data at lines 282 to 295.
prepareLayout takes graph: KnowledgeGraph and iterates graph.edges (GraphEdge[]), reading edge.source and edge.target at lines 86 to 87 and 106 to 107.
In KnowledgeNodeDetails, meta is assigned node.knowledgeMeta where node is typed GraphNode, so meta is KnowledgeMeta | undefined and meta.wikilinks and meta.content are read.

In DomainNodeDetails, meta is assigned node.domainMeta where node is typed GraphNode, so meta is DomainMeta | undefined and entities, businessRules, crossDomainInteractions and entryPoint are read from it.
In KnowledgeNodeDetails and DomainNodeDetails the prop graph is typed KnowledgeGraph and callbacks over graph.edges (GraphEdge[]) read e.source and e.target.
buildChatContext takes graph: KnowledgeGraph imported from @understand-anything/core, whose project property is ProjectMeta, and reads graph.project.languages and graph.project.frameworks.
getAuthCredential takes auth: AuthResult | undefined, whose auth property is declared ModelAuth, and reads auth.auth.apiKey and auth.auth.headers.
In _getRequiredRequestAuth, result is typed AuthResult | undefined (auth: ModelAuth) and result.auth.apiKey, result.auth.headers and result.auth.baseUrl are read.
describeProvider takes provider: Provider from pi-ai/compat, whose readonly auth property is ProviderAuth, and reads provider.auth.apiKey and provider.auth.oauth.

registerNativeProvider takes provider: Provider imported from @earendil-works/pi-ai (auth: ProviderAuth) and reads provider.auth.oauth and provider.auth.apiKey at line 900, with provider.auth.oauth also read via getProvider at line 548.
composeApiKeyAuth and composeOAuthAuth take base: Provider | undefined (auth: ProviderAuth) and read base?.auth.apiKey and base?.auth.oauth at lines 423, 425 and 489.
requests is typed ModelRouteRequest[] whose failed property is declared { model; thinkingLevel?; message: AssistantMessage }, and requests[1].failed?.message.errorMessage and .stopReason are read.
setup is the ChatSetup returned by chatSetup(), whose faux is FauxProviderHandle with state: FauxProviderState, and setup.faux.state.callCount and setup.faux.state.deferredFetchCount are read.
setup is a ChatSetup (from chatSetup() or a ChatSetup parameter) whose faux property is FauxProviderHandle, and the file calls setup.faux.setResponses and reads setup.faux.state.
setup is a ChatSetup whose faux.state is FauxProviderState, and setup.faux.state.callCount, .deferredFetchCount and .cancelledDeferred are read at lines 227, 280 and 323.
setup is a ChatSetup whose faux is FauxProviderHandle, and setup.faux.setResponses, setup.faux.getPendingResponseCount and setup.faux.state are accessed.
